title: Q-TENANT-row-isolation: tenant_id on core rows and scoped tick queries
body:
**Owner:** platform
**Trigger:** every PR (checks.yml)
**Done check:** file:seed/worker/migrations/0026_tenant_core.sql
**Status:** closed
**Evidence:** migration 0026_tenant_core.sql adds tenant_id (NULL = own) to items, claims, gate_cards and trust_ledger; reconcile, reap_claims, probe_gates, accrue_trust, dispatch (pickForRole, WIP), execute (doer), the item and gate metrics, handoff setItem and the native executor are scoped to tenant_id IS NULL OR the org slug; seed/worker/test/tenant-isolation.test.js passes 14 of 14 (10 fail without the scoping); seed worker suite 365 of 365

Migration adding tenant_id to items, claims, gate cards and trust rows; tick queries scoped by tenant; isolation tests. Filed at thread close; the executor works it in driver order.
